metadata.title: Buffalo and Erie County website/SEO competitor inventory
metadata.scope: Official provider pages checked for Buffalo, Erie County, or an explicitly served Buffalo market. Providers are direct website/SEO alternatives, premium comparables, or local productized substitutes; directories, resellers, and listing pages are excluded.
metadata.evidence_rule: Prices are provider asking prices, not completed transactions. Provider performance, ranking, speed, review, and client-count statements remain self-reported unless independently measured; no performance claim is inferred here.

competitors.positioning: Accessible small-business launch packages, then a path to a full custom redesign.

offers.name: SmartStart Essential
offers.scope: Standard design to match logo, contact form, essential SEO, social links, up to 20 formatted pages, mobile-responsive, two years hosting.

offers.name: SmartStart Enhanced
offers.scope: Essential plus two enhancements such as slideshow, gallery, calendar, or blog.

posted_pricing.caveat: Full custom build is quote-only; SmartStart terms and ownership should be read with the provider's terms page.

competitors.proof_and_terms: Portfolio, training/support and a stated full-custom upgrade path are visible; package-specific ownership, cancellation payoff and export details were not established on the pricing page.
competitors.mobile_ui_pattern: The provider states mobile-first/mobile-responsive work. The reviewed page uses a clear package comparison, persistent service navigation, and a contact CTA; this is an observed interface pattern, not a measured performance result.

sources.evidence: Posted SmartStart prices, term and inclusions.
Mobile-first, SEO/coding, training and process claims.
General terms link retained for package-specific review.

competitors.positioning: A named founder promises direct access, plain-language fixed choices, and a site that keeps changing with the business.

offers.name: New Website + Care
offers.scope: Full custom website, copy/page strategy, launch in 4-8 weeks, ongoing updates; one hour of care monthly in year one and two hours after year one.

offers.name: New Website
offers.scope: Standalone full custom website, copy/page strategy, full access and ownership after final payment; care optional at $250/month.

posted_pricing.caveat: The page calls first-year care-plan total $3,500 and standalone total $4,400; hosting is estimated at $25-35/month and domain at $20-30/year, billed directly.

competitors.proof_and_terms: Plan comparison, process, client testimonials and domain/ownership language are public. Care-plan site-owner role transfers within 10 business days after cancellation; standalone access follows final payment.
competitors.mobile_ui_pattern: The page uses a side-by-side plan comparison, milestone language and repeated start CTAs. No measured mobile/performance result was observed.
keywords_and_pages_observed: custom web design for small businesses

sources.evidence: Pricing, scope, care hours, ownership, payment and timeline.

competitors.positioning: Fixed-price, fast-launch packages framed as below local market rates for small businesses.

offers.name: Launch
offers.scope: Three-page custom site, one year domain/hosting/email/SSL, mobile/tablet responsive, form, GBP setup, 5-7 business days.

offers.name: Business
offers.term: one-time build plus optional Basic Care
offers.scope: Six pages, pricing/services, testimonials, local SEO setup, Analytics, social links, auto-reply form, 30 days support; Basic Care adds backups, SSL/uptime monitoring and one hour edits.

offers.name: Full Launch
offers.scope: Eight-plus pages, branding, blog, booking, advanced lead capture, integrations, performance optimization and 60 days managed support.

posted_pricing.caveat: Care is listed at $39/$79/$129 per month; post-year-one domain/hosting is estimated at $30-50/year. Provider's 40% market comparison is an unverified claim.

competitors.proof_and_terms: Credentials handover and a review-before-launch process are stated; detailed case studies or independent outcomes were not established in the reviewed page.
competitors.mobile_ui_pattern: The page explicitly lists mobile/tablet responsiveness and uses package cards with inclusions, delivery windows and add-ons. No measured speed result is inferred.

sources.evidence: Current package prices, inclusions, delivery and care page.

competitors.positioning: Small-business, nonprofit, author and personal-site design with simple published packages and one-to-one service.

offers.name: Basic redesign
offers.scope: Home, About, Product/Services and Contact pages, social links, six client photos and up to four stock assets.

offers.name: Basic hosted website
offers.term: one year hosting included; renewal unknown
offers.scope: Above plus hosting, SSL, daily backups and malware scans.

offers.name: Maintenance
offers.scope: One hour of maintenance monthly; pay-as-you-go option is $75/hour.

posted_pricing.caveat: Domain, later hosting and package ownership/cancellation terms were not established on the reviewed page.

competitors.proof_and_terms: Public portfolio and named testimonials, including WNY organizations, are visible; outcomes are testimonial claims, not independently audited results.
competitors.mobile_ui_pattern: Responsive phone/tablet/computer language, package lists, portfolio thumbnails and a quote CTA are visible. No measured performance claim is made.

sources.evidence: Package prices, inclusions, maintenance and portfolio/testimonials.

competitors.positioning: A managed website and response system that turns calls, forms, texts and reviews into one contractor workflow.

offers.name: SIMPLE
offers.scope: Mobile-friendly one-page site, services/photos/reviews, click-to-call, form, email notifications, connected Google Profile and system access.

offers.name: PRO
offers.scope: Customized 20-page site, SEO boost and city pages, 10-second text-back, unified inbox, review engine and unlimited website updates.

posted_pricing.caveat: The reviewed current page says no hidden setup fees and no long-term contracts; older indexed copy and FAQ language have changed, so a written quote controls.

competitors.proof_and_terms: Free mockup CTA, feature comparison and an interactive ROI calculator are visible; calculator outputs are illustrations and not proof of customer revenue.
competitors.mobile_ui_pattern: Mobile-friendly one-page positioning, package comparison, sliders and ROI calculator are prominent. No independent speed or conversion measurement is inferred.

sources.evidence: Current SIMPLE/PRO prices, feature matrix, cancellation FAQ and calculator.
Terms link retained for agreement review.

competitors.positioning: SEO implementation for small businesses, with technical foundations and a Buffalo-specific local-search lane.

offers.name: SEO Starter
offers.scope: Technical audit/fixes, 15 target keywords, up to 10 pages, GBP setup, five citations, monthly report and Analytics/Search Console setup.

offers.name: SEO Professional
offers.scope: 30 target keywords, up to 25 pages, two posts/month, 15 citations, competitor analysis, five advertised backlinks/month, schema, strategy call and priority email.

offers.name: SEO Enterprise
offers.scope: 50-plus keywords, unlimited pages, four posts/month, 30-plus citations, 15 advertised backlinks/month, CRO/A-B testing and account management.

offers.name: One-Time SEO
offers.scope: Technical/on-page/local work as agreed; not every monthly deliverable.

posted_pricing.caveat: Backlink quality, outcomes and fulfillment were not independently verified; the provider expressly says no ranking guarantee.

competitors.proof_and_terms: Free audit, dated Buffalo SEO content and a client testimonial are visible; no audited outcome is assumed.
competitors.mobile_ui_pattern: Service page lists mobile-first indexing, Core Web Vitals, schema and a six-step process. A free audit CTA and package comparison reduce the first interaction to one action.

sources.evidence: Current SEO package prices, 3-month minimum, inclusions and no-guarantee language.
Buffalo web design/custom development positioning and technology pages.

competitors.positioning: Long-running Buffalo-based full-service digital marketing team with tiered SEO and broad channel coverage.

offers.name: SEO Essentials
offers.scope: Low-risk small-business/startup SEO; exact quantities not visible on reviewed page.

offers.name: SEO Standard
offers.scope: General optimization; exact quantities not visible on reviewed page.

offers.name: SEO Premium
offers.scope: Advanced/wide-reaching SEO; exact quantities not visible on reviewed page.

offers.name: SEO Custom
offers.scope: Full-service custom SEO; exact quantities not visible on reviewed page.

posted_pricing.caveat: Annual billing, refund/cancellation and tier deliverables require a quote or agreement; do not compare rates as equivalent monthly scopes.

competitors.proof_and_terms: Provider states Buffalo and Las Vegas locations, 25-plus years of experience, a resource library and a named customer testimonial; results remain provider/client statements.
competitors.mobile_ui_pattern: The page uses a broad service mega-navigation, package cards, resource content and repeated call/contact actions. No measured mobile or speed result was taken.

sources.evidence: Posted starting rates, local/technical/analytics inclusions, Buffalo location and experience claim.

competitors.positioning: A local, long-running one-stop digital provider combining hand-coded sites, search, hosting, accessibility and visual/360 assets.

posted_pricing.scope: Every project is quoted after consultation; hosting, domain, photography, video and tours are shown as optional items.

competitors.proof_and_terms: The official site states Buffalo service since 1999, publishes case studies with live links, describes client-controlled domains/files and includes an accessibility target; client testimonials and volume claims are self-reported.
competitors.mobile_ui_pattern: The provider states responsive phone/tablet/desktop design and hand-written HTML/CSS. The reviewed site exposes a deep service menu, free quote CTA, case studies and review section; no actual performance measurement is inferred.

sources.evidence: Buffalo location, service breadth, responsive/hand-coded claims, testimonials and navigation.
Included launch SEO/accessibility, custom quote, ownership and optional-cost language.
Buffalo/WNY case studies with live-site links.

competitors.positioning: Owner-led local support with defined packages, agreements and a broad online/IT relationship.

posted_pricing.scope: Standard up to 5 pages, Business up to 10 pages, Enterprise up to 20 pages; build plus first full year of hosting/upkeep/support is included in total project investment, but dollar prices are not public.

competitors.package_inclusions: Standard lists basic SEO, mobile optimization, 1-2 revisions, light animation, WCAG 2.0, Analytics and 12 months support; Business adds CMS/SEO structure/conversion layout; Enterprise adds advanced SEO, performance, animation and integrations.
competitors.proof_and_terms: The site states 30-plus clients since 2019, named client testimonials and a direct owner relationship; no independent performance evidence is assumed.
competitors.mobile_ui_pattern: Package comparison, a pricing calculator, a 30-minute discovery CTA and mobile-optimization language are visible. Actual mobile performance was not measured.

sources.evidence: Local services, owner-led positioning, client proof and CTA.
Package page, scope, inclusions, first-year support and quote-only terms.

competitors.positioning: Locally based WordPress and SEO-first builds for businesses across Erie County, with Orchard Park and Lancaster offices.

posted_pricing.scope: Free quote; no public project or monthly SEO dollar rate on the reviewed home page.

competitors.proof_and_terms: Recent work links to Buffalo, Tonawanda and East Aurora projects; offices and Erie County coverage are public. Ownership, cancellation and detailed package limits were not established.
competitors.mobile_ui_pattern: The page leads with rank/load/convert messaging, service cards, a portfolio CTA and location coverage. Responsive/custom language is present; no measured speed claim is inferred.

sources.evidence: Services, offices, Erie County coverage, recent work and quote CTA.

competitors.positioning: Build once, then operate the public website and repeated updates through an owner-friendly managed service.

offers.name: Presence
offers.scope: Custom one-page site, domain/SSL, mobile-optimized design, call/booking/form, local SEO foundations, chat updates and quality checks.

offers.name: Growth
offers.scope: Presence plus multi-page custom site, booking/basic ecommerce, GBP connection where supported, review monitoring, performance receipt and priority support.

offers.name: Scale
offers.scope: Growth plus content engine, multi-location, integrations and deeper reporting.

posted_pricing.caveat: Custom build is quoted separately; connected services, integrations and export/repository handoff are defined in accepted scope.

competitors.proof_and_terms: Built in Buffalo, with public demos, free audits, weekly-receipt concept, domain ownership and cancellation/export language. Demos and provider claims are not paid-client outcome evidence.
competitors.mobile_ui_pattern: Mobile-optimized package language, dashboard/chat change request, approval gates and weekly reporting are central interface patterns; no independent performance result is inferred.

sources.evidence: Current monthly packages, terms, ownership and scope boundaries.
Buffalo page, launch standard, ownership and no-ranking-fiction language.
Buffalo origin, productized workflow and demo/audit navigation.

competitors.positioning: Full-service digital agency built around partnership, broad creative/development capability and data-driven marketing.

posted_pricing.scope: No public website or SEO dollar rate found on reviewed pages.

competitors.proof_and_terms: Buffalo office, case-study navigation, 15-plus years in web design, certified partners and a broad service taxonomy are public. Clutch has historical client-spend bands; they are recorded separately as buyer evidence, not current price quotes.
competitors.mobile_ui_pattern: The root page uses a large service mega-menu, case-study and client links, partner badges, blog/resource filters and contact CTA. Responsive/performance behavior was not measured from text sources.

sources.evidence: Buffalo address, service taxonomy, case studies, partner badges and 15-plus-year design claim.
Historical buyer review records, retained as spending evidence with date/scope caveat.

competitors.positioning: Collaborative, WordPress-based custom sites with a free homepage/risk-reversal offer and ongoing support.

posted_pricing.scope: Dollar price not public; page says a homepage can be designed/built free and payment waits until the buyer loves it, with refund/satisfaction language.

competitors.proof_and_terms: Buffalo address, a 5.0 rating display, named logo/client portfolio, industry list, 6-8 week standard timing, training, account management and hosting/support are visible. Guarantee conditions are not independently validated beyond provider page.
competitors.mobile_ui_pattern: Provider describes responsive design, interactive maps, data visualizations, bold imagery and clean layouts. The page uses a process sequence, free-audit CTA, long intake form and booking CTA; no measured result is inferred.

sources.evidence: Buffalo offer, process, inclusions, risk reversal, responsive language and proof sections.

competitors.positioning: Performance-driven integrated agency with in-house specialists and full-funnel marketing.

posted_pricing.scope: No public website or SEO price found on the reviewed official pages.

competitors.proof_and_terms: Official site lists Buffalo and Rochester offices, 16 years in business, 40 in-house marketers, client testimonials, case-study/work navigation and a frequently updated resource library. These are provider-published proof signals, not a claim of superior outcomes.
competitors.mobile_ui_pattern: The site organizes services under solutions, creative, technology and data, then exposes work, people and resource content with repeated start-project CTAs. No mobile/performance measurement was performed.

sources.evidence: Buffalo address, service model, in-house/team claims, testimonials and proof/navigation.
Official website design/development solution URL; page fetch was intermittent, so no unobserved detail is asserted.

competitors.positioning: Published fixed-scope coded tiers with bundled launch SEO and explicit Erie County expansion coverage.

offers.name: Starter
offers.term: 3 months hosting free, then $69/mo; one month SEO bundled
offers.scope: 1-5 pages, hand-coded Next.js, mobile-first, form, local schema and on-page SEO.

offers.name: Growth
offers.term: 6 months hosting free, then $129/mo; three months SEO bundled
offers.scope: 6-15 pages, blog/CMS, local SEO/service-area pages, three months ongoing SEO.

offers.name: Authority
offers.term: 12 months hosting free, then $269/mo; six months SEO bundled
offers.scope: Unlimited pages, Analytics/call tracking, monthly report and AI-search optimization.

offers.name: Managed Local SEO
offers.term: No long-term contract claim; precise notice requires quote
offers.scope: Geo-grid tracking, two content pieces/month, strategy call and link acquisition at one or two placements/quarter.

posted_pricing.caveat: Page uses self-reported Lighthouse/PageSpeed and ranking language; none is treated as a measured result here. Content changes and features outside tiers are separate; hosting cancellation is stated at 30 days.

competitors.proof_and_terms: Provider says every shipped site is visible on its work page and offers a free site audit; these are provider claims. It explicitly lists Buffalo, Amherst, Cheektowaga and Tonawanda in Erie County coverage.
competitors.mobile_ui_pattern: Package cards, instant-estimate questions, free-audit CTA, local directory pages and fixed-scope FAQ create a low-friction buying path. Mobile-first/Lighthouse claims are unmeasured provider statements.

sources.evidence: Current 2026 build tiers, hosting, bundled SEO, payment and cancellation terms.
Managed SEO price/scope, Erie County coverage and service-area pages.
Regional Buffalo/Erie service positioning.

buyer_spend_evidence.caveat: Exact payment is undisclosed; a review band is not an invoice or local median.

buyer_spend_evidence.scope: Design and HTML/CSS source assets, Mar-Apr/May 2020; client integrated the assets
buyer_spend_evidence.reported_spend: About $10,000 in interview; review header also says under $10,000
buyer_spend_evidence.caveat: Preserve the discrepancy; this is not a full independent website-build price.

buyer_spend_evidence.scope: Custom WordPress/plugins, search and library calendar, Aug 2019-Feb 2020; $250/month support separately stated
buyer_spend_evidence.caveat: Older, complex and partly anonymous; not comparable to a bounded brochure site.

buyer_spend_evidence.scope: Brand, website redesign and marketing plan, Feb 2024-Jan 2025
buyer_spend_evidence.caveat: Recent but bundled and nonlocal; website allocation is unknown.

buyer_spend_evidence.scope: Platform migration, responsive design, maintenance/security; ecommerce expansion planned, May 2019-ongoing
buyer_spend_evidence.caveat: Ongoing mixed scope; do not assume planned ecommerce was purchased or isolate website-only spend.

buyer_spend_limit: These five public records establish examples and broad bands only. They do not establish a current Erie County median, a completed 2025-2026 local website-only price, or a defensible percentage discount for Wonder and Method.
